# Beta 1.0.12 · November 2026

## Things that read differently
- Text now has three roles in both apps: the system font for the interface, a serif for titles and longer reading, and a monospace font for code only. Sizes come from one scale, and labels are no longer set in spaced capitals.
- Lines are drawn one way everywhere: one pixel wide, with one named style for each job, whether the line divides a list, edges a card or a control, or marks a warning.
- A pane scrolls only where it is meant to. The chat can no longer be dragged sideways, and no message shows above the date band at the top of a chat.

## Things that behave better
- Two security fixes, for every install: the nightly memory tidy-up, and text that reaches an agent from outside, can no longer get at files they have no business with. Update when this release is offered to you.
- When an account reaches a usage limit you get one notice about it, not several, and picking an account by hand checks it first.
- An agent's browser can print a local file to PDF from inside its sandbox.
